Closes lane-reachability rule 6: a tsconfig.spec.json with no compiling target lets the spec corpus carry type errors no gate can see (nx.json production namedInput excludes it). The ratchet fails on any per-file increase over tools/nx-plugins/build/executors/typecheck-spec/policy-core-client.baseline.json or on include narrowing. Wired into test.dependsOn so nx affected -t test runs it.
